metadata.description: Reusable methods for working with AI agents, from shaping a request to delivering work someone else can use.

plugins.name: aaron-skills
plugins.description: Shape an unclear request into an inspectable proposal, build it with the project's existing methods, verify the actual result, demonstrate it as a guided video, and hand it off. Shape, Build, Verify and Deliver work on their own; Capture, Film and Share additionally need the local aaron-demo runtime, and say so when it is missing.
